**Returns:**

A runtime with no operations registered.

## Remarks

The executor is fixed at construction; every invocation dispatches through it. Governance is either a context or a loader that runs on first use (see [CreateRuntimeOptions.governance](./runtime.createruntimeoptions.governance.md)<!-- -->). It is required: hosts that act for this Mac pass `loadHostGovernance`<!-- -->, and anything else states the governance it enforces.
